scientific_integrity: Finite numerical checks supplement analytic root-of-unity and composition proofs; priority not independently established. Initiating dated manuscript bears October 2, 2006, but its earliest web upload date is not separately documented.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly selected distinct vertices of regular polygons, strict center containment, no conditional statistic for the four-vertex case; arbitrary cyclic sets, boundary inclusion, and higher moments are not included.
title: Conditional area moments for center-containing regular-polygon triangles
